items.source: The match type that should be used for the selection.
items.translation: 应使用的选择匹配类型。

items.source: A @Selector may change the way that the endpoint is exposed to the user. For example, HTTP mapped endpoints will map select parameters to path variables.
items.translation: @Selector 可能会改变端点向用户暴露的方式。例如，HTTP 映射的端点会将选择参数映射为路径变量。

items.source: Match types that can be used with the @Selector.
items.translation: 可与@Selector一起使用的匹配类型。
